title: 第562章 金蟾第561章 司徒南
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“你们过来。”
他对着这几个女修招了招手。
“好的！”
这几个女修似乎很害怕司徒南，犹豫了一下还是走过去了，走到了司徒南的身边。
司徒南更是不废话，直接将一个炼气期女修抱在了怀里，一双毛茸茸的大手就伸到了这个女修的衣服里去了。
女修的身体连抽搐起来，明亮的大眼睛里也是满了泪水。
“呵呵，司徒兄还是这么风流啊？”
看到这里，星耀则笑嘻嘻地道，给司徒南倒了一杯酒水。
“呵呵，人不风流怎么行。”
司徒南哈哈大笑起来，摸得更加过瘾了。
“司徒南，这个神木王鼎怎么说？”
过了一会儿，金花婆婆则询问道。
毕竟本来金花婆婆是打算和星耀联手取出神木王鼎的，在这里原本是她和星耀实力最高，两人都是金丹中期修士。
但是现在来了司徒南就不一样了，毕竟司徒南的境界比她和星耀还要强，万一司徒南抢神木王鼎，就麻烦了。
“怎么说，自然是实力为尊了，谁抢到神木王鼎就是谁的。”
司徒南恶狠狠地道，司徒南仗着自己实力雄厚，认为自己在秘境里一定能抢到神木王鼎的。
“呵呵，司徒南，这次怕是你抢不到了，你可知道神木王鼎在秘境的什么地方？”
金花婆婆冷笑起来。
“哦，好像是在火云洞穴吧？怎么了？”
司徒南则好奇地询问道，他看过资料，神木王鼎就是在秘境的火云洞穴里。

“没错，你可知道火云洞穴里有什么吗？”
金花婆婆继续笑道。
“有妖兽，不过什么妖兽能挡得住老夫的飞剑？”
司徒南冷笑道，毕竟司徒南是金丹期大圆满的修为，他炼制了一把飞剑厉害无比，可以击杀5级以下的妖兽。
这个火云洞穴的资料他看过，的确有妖兽守护，不过妖兽的等级才4级不到，自然不用担心。
“没错，妖兽是其一，第二就是洞穴里有冥火。”
金花婆婆说道。
“冥火，就是传说中的地狱之火，无物不融的地狱火。”
司徒南变了脸色，他看过古籍知道了这个世界上有一种很恐怖的火焰，冥火，也就是地狱之火。
这个火焰就算是元婴期修士都抵挡不住，如果被冥火碰到了身体，不光肉体被融化，灵魂都会魂飞魄散。
“没错！就是冥火，司徒南你虽然很强，不会认为能抵挡得住冥火吧。”
金花婆婆则笑嘻嘻地道。
司徒南沉默了，他自认为自己肉身无敌，但是也不敢去触碰冥火。
“婆婆，莫非你有什么办法可以将神木王鼎从满是冥火的洞穴里取出来？”
司徒南询问道，目光炯炯地看着金花婆婆。
content_en:
"Come here."
He waved to these female cultivators.
"Okay!"
These female cultivators seemed to be afraid of Situ Nan, so they hesitated for a moment before walking over to Situ Nan's side.
Situ Nan didn't waste any time and directly hugged a female cultivator in the Qi Refining stage, and put his big furry hands into the female cultivator's clothes.
The female cultivator's body began to twitch, and her big bright eyes were filled with tears.
"Haha, Brother Situ is still so romantic?"
Seeing this, Xingyao smiled and poured Situ Nan a glass of wine.
"Haha, how can you do it if you are not romantic?"
Situ Nan burst out laughing, feeling even more satisfied.
"Situ Nan, what do you say about this sacred wooden king tripod?"
After a while, Granny Jinhua asked.
After all, Granny Jinhua originally planned to team up with Xingyao to take out the Divine Wood King Cauldron. She and Xingyao were originally the most powerful here, and both of them were middle-stage Jindan monks.
But now that Situ Nan is here, it's different. After all, Situ Nan's realm is stronger than her and Xingyao. If Situ Nan robs the sacred wooden king tripod, there will be trouble.
"What should I say? Strength is of course the most important thing. Whoever grabs the Divine Wood King Cauldron belongs to him."
Situ Nan said fiercely, Situ Nan relied on his strong strength and believed that he would definitely be able to grab the sacred wooden king tripod in the secret realm.
"Haha, Situ Nan, I'm afraid you won't be able to grab it this time. Do you know where the Divine Wood King Cauldron is in the secret realm?"
Granny Jinhua sneered.
"Oh, it seems to be in the Fire Cloud Cave, right? What's wrong?"
Situ Nan asked curiously. He had read the information and found that the Divine Wood King Cauldron was in the Fire Cloud Cave in the secret realm.
"That's right, do you know what's in the Fire Cloud Cave?"
Grandma Jinhua continued to laugh.
"There are monsters, but what monster can block my flying sword?"
Situ Nan sneered and said, after all, Situ Nan is at the Golden Core stage of Dzogchen. He has refined a flying sword that is so powerful that it can kill monsters below level 5.
He had read the information about the Fire Cloud Cave, and it was indeed guarded by monsters, but the monsters were only at level 4, so there was no need to worry.
"Yes, one is the monster beast, and the other is that there is Hellfire in the cave."
Grandma Jinhua said.
"The fire of hell is the legendary fire of hell, the fire of hell that melts everything."
Situ Nan's expression changed. He had read ancient books and learned that there was a very terrifying flame in this world, the underworld fire, which was the fire of hell.
Even monks at the Nascent Soul stage cannot withstand this flame. If the body is touched by the underworld fire, not only will the body be melted, but the soul will be scattered.
"That's right! It's the Hell Fire. Although you are very strong, Situ Nan, you don't think you can withstand the Hell Fire."
Grandma Jinhua said with a smile.
Situ Nan was silent. He thought he was physically invincible, but he did not dare to touch the Hell Fire.
"Mother-in-law, is there any way you can take out the sacred wooden king tripod from the cave full of hellfire?"
Situ Nan asked, looking at Grandma Jinhua with piercing eyes.
